{{Quote|You never know what I might have in stock, and my prices are always better than those crooks at Czerka Corp!|translated=1|Crattis Yurkal saying goodbye to a customer|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Aratech Mercantile''' was an armaments shop during the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]]. Located within the [[Jedi Enclave]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], the shop was run by [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Crattis Yurkal]]. The Twi'lek [[Karal Kaar]], an employee of [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech Droids, Inc.]], also worked from this location.
